casino:already_bet: The seat has already staked this hand — one bet per seat per hand
casino:already_seated: The caller already holds a seat at a table (one seat per player, game-wide)
casino:game_error: The game's own code threw while handling the step (its message rides along as `detail`)
casino:house_cannot_cover: The house owner's cash cannot cover the maximum possible payout for the wager (or the table's total exposure)
casino:insufficient_funds: Caller's cash cannot cover the wager, raise, or table bet
casino:invalid_action: The action body fails the game's own action schema
casino:invalid_game_multiplier: Installed-game defect: the game declares a non-finite or negative maxPayoutMultiplier
casino:invalid_payout: Installed-game defect at settle: a negative payout figure, or (tables) a payout naming a seat not in the hand or the same seat twice
casino:invalid_turn: Hub/game defect: the table's turn points at no live seat, an acting table has no turn or state, or the lazy clock exhausted its passes without the game advancing the hand
casino:invalid_wager_delta: Installed-game defect: the game raised a stake it was not entitled to raise (negative/non-positive delta, from the clock or a non-acting seat, or a seat with no stake)
casino:no_location: The caller is not in any town
casino:no_session: The caller has no casino session at all (or the row is gone)
casino:no_such_game: That game id is not in the registry (game plugin not installed or not registered)
casino:no_such_table: The table chosen for sit is gone (deleted after settling empty) — a retry opens a fresh one
casino:not_seated: The caller has no seat — never sat, or their seat/table was idle-swept, settled away, or deleted
casino:not_your_turn: It is another seat's turn to act
casino:session_closed: The caller's most recent session is already settled — nothing open to act on
casino:session_expired: The open hand is past its expiry and cannot be played (it will be forfeited on the next `play`)
casino:session_open: The caller already has a live, unexpired open hand
casino:table_full: The table already has the maximum number of seats
casino:unauthorized: No authenticated player on the request
casino:wager_above_max: Wager exceeds the house's maximum bet (the owner's lever, or the default when unset)
casino:wager_below_min: Wager is below the configured minimum bet
casino:wrong_location: The caller has travelled away from the table's town (bet/act refused; leave still works)
casino:wrong_phase: The request does not match the table's phase (betting during a live hand, or acting during betting/with no hand state)
combat:cooldown: Attack cooldown live (`retry-after` header carries the wait; a refused attack still burns it)
combat:hospitalised: The caller is in hospital (re-checked under the lock; same 423 the loader gate sends)
combat:insufficient_bullets: The caller holds fewer bullets than the weapon needs per shot
combat:insufficient_energy: Opening an engagement costs half the caller's max energy and their energy pool is below it
combat:insufficient_funds: Caller's cash cannot cover the repair cost
combat:jailed: The caller is in jail (re-checked under the lock; same 423 the loader gate sends)
combat:no_detective_report: The town is underground and the caller holds no live detective report on the target
combat:protected: Newbie protection: either party is below the exp threshold (mutual — below it you can neither attack nor be attacked)
combat:same_gang: Target is in the caller's gang
combat:target_elsewhere: Target is not in the caller's town
combat:unauthorized: No authenticated player on the request (or the caller's own stats row is missing)
combat:weapon_not_found: The item is not a weapon the caller owns (repair refused)
core:already_hospitalised: The caller is already in hospital and cannot check in again.
core:already_jailed: The caller is in jail themselves and cannot attempt a bust.
core:already_verified: The account's email is already verified; there is nothing to resend.
core:banned: The caller's account is banned (a live ban with an unexpired or permanent term).
core:cannot_ban_self: A moderator cannot ban their own account.
core:cannot_delete_own_role: An admin cannot delete the role they themselves hold (self-lockout protection).
core:cannot_demote_self: An admin cannot change their own role assignment (self-lockout protection).
core:cannot_revoke_own_role: An admin cannot revoke a module grant from their own role (self-lockout protection).
core:email_taken: The requested email address is already registered to another account.
core:email_unverified: The caller has not yet verified their email address, which gates all play beyond the verify/resend routes.
core:entity_required: Binding art to a per-entity slot requires an entityId naming which row (item, town, rank) the image belongs to.
core:forbidden: The caller's role lacks the module grant this admin resource requires.
core:hospitalised: The caller is currently in hospital and this action is blocked until the stay ends (Retry-After gives the seconds remaining).
core:insufficient_energy: The caller lacks the 10 energy a jail-bust attempt costs.
core:insufficient_funds: The caller cannot afford the fee (bail or hospital discharge) this action charges.
core:invalid_body: The request body failed validation — it must name a valid target player id.
core:invalid_code: The email verification code is wrong, expired, or already used.
core:invalid_color: A theme color override is not a valid hex color string (blank means no override).
core:invalid_credentials: The login username and password do not match any account.
core:invalid_game_name: The submitted game name is longer than 60 characters (blank falls back to the default).
core:invalid_kind: The requested leaderboard/standings kind is not a recognized board kind.
core:invalid_preset: The submitted theme preset name is not one of the known presets.
core:invalid_request: The request's body, URL parameters, or query string failed schema validation.
core:invalid_scope: The leaderboard scope query must be "round" or "all".
core:invalid_token: The password reset token is wrong, expired, or already used.
core:invalid_window: The round's end time must be after its start time.
core:jailed: The caller is currently in jail and this action is blocked until the sentence ends (Retry-After gives the seconds remaining).
core:no_email: The account has no email address on file, so a verification code cannot be sent.
core:not_found: No stored asset exists under the given content-hash key.
core:not_hospitalised: The player this acts on is not currently in hospital.
core:not_injured: The caller is at full health, so there is nothing a hospital stay would heal.
core:not_jailed: The player this acts on is not currently serving a jail sentence.
core:player_not_found: The named player does not exist (or the caller's own player row is missing).
core:rate_limited: The caller has made too many requests to this route in the current window; try again later.
core:role_in_use: The role is still assigned to at least one player; unassign every holder before deleting it.
core:role_not_found: No role exists with the given id.
core:round_finalized: The round has already been settled into the hall of fame and can no longer be edited.
core:round_not_found: No round exists with the given id.
core:round_not_scheduled: Only a round that has not yet started can be deleted; this one is active, ended, or finalized.
core:round_overlap: The round's time window overlaps another unfinalized round.
core:self_target: The caller targeted themselves; bail, bust, and paid discharge only work on another player.
core:unauthorized: The caller is not logged in (no valid session token was presented).
core:unknown_module: The grant's module key does not match any loaded module, so the grant would silently do nothing.
core:unknown_slot: The named art slot is not declared by any loaded plugin or core registry (for page-banner fetches, it must also be a singleton slot).
core:unsupported_media_type: The asset upload body was not raw image bytes with a recognized image content type.
core:username_taken: The requested username is already registered to another account.
core:wrong_location: The target player is not in the caller's own town, and this action only reaches local players.
crimes:crime_not_found: No crime exists with that id (commit attempt, or admin update/delete of a missing row)
crimes:insufficient_<var>: The crime prices a cost in an attribute pool (brave, energy, ...) that the caller cannot pay; the code names the pool, e.g. insufficient_brave

crimes:on_cooldown: Crime cooldown live (`retryAfter` in details and the `retry-after` header carry the wait)

detectives:cannot_search_self: Caller tried to hire detectives on themselves
detectives:insufficient_funds: Caller's cash cannot cover the hire cost (wealth-scaled unit x detectives x hours)
detectives:not_found: No such search of the caller's to remove — a nonexistent id and another player's search answer identically by design

detectives:unauthorized: No authenticated player on the request
